item.tib: spyi rgyug mdos mchong rin chen 'phreng ba
item.coloph: de ltar mdos rgyud la (las/)gsang 'dus gshen gyi mdos rgyud la/ no bo kha'i 'grel ba dang*/ gsal byed me long rnam gsum/ lha 'dre stong gis (gi)drwa ba/ ma mo 'bum gyi bem chag mkha'aklong gsang ba'i mdos chen/ dkar po mtha' spel mdos gzhung gling gzhi srid pa'i spyi mdos/ 'phrin las mdos mchong rnam gnyis la sogs kyi nang nas nyung du bsdus pa'o//
